producer_judgment.rationale: Both are Primary One Performance Objectives under the same Theme (Mensuration and Geometry) and Sub-Theme (Shapes). The first asks pupils to 'distinguish between squares and rectangles' (Topic: 2. Two dimensional shapes); the second to 'distinguish between cuboids and cubes' (Topic: 1. Three dimensional shapes). They apply the same discrimination skill to different shape categories (2D vs 3D), making them parallel, complementary skills with genuine conceptual coherence. Neither is a developmental prerequisite for the other, and both share rank 0 (PRIMARY ONE) with no substantive evidence of a directional dependency, so relatesTo is preferred over buildsTowards. Token/trigram overlap and page proximity are largely due to the shared 'distinguish between ... and ...' template and shared parentage, which alone do not establish direction.
